company_notes:
Inbound from self-serve signups. Started with free credits, small POC to replace legacy FAQ bot.

Summary:
- Tech lead: Maya Chen (CTO) on call 2026-02-19.
- Wants Hosted API (public cloud) — fastest time to value.
- Primary workloads: chat + embeddings for semantic search; low QPS initially (50-200 qpm), latency target p95 < 300ms for chat.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Wants guidance on token/unit economics and intelligent batching suggestions.
- Procurement: prefers credit card for early stage but may need invoice for later pilot if additional budget approved.
- Asks: startup discount, extended free credits for 6-week POC, clear documentation on rate limits and quota bump path.
- Security: needs SSO (SAML) and audit logs; overall SOC2 mention is helpful but not critical now.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- "We can pilot on cards but if the business team signs off we'll need invoice terms." — CTO
- "Need to understand cost run-rate at scale before committing to monthly reserved capacity." — Growth PM

Procurement notes / recommended approach:
- Offer: extend additional $2k in credits for 6-week POC tied to specific evaluation metrics (accuracy on 3 sample flows + latency).
- Pricing options: standard self-serve (card on file) OR simple invoice for pilot (Net 30) pending finance approval. SE to confirm billing contact and invoice threshold.
- Apply startup discount (Redwood early-stage program) if they qualify — ask for YC/YC-alumni or similar verification.

POC scope suggestion:
- Connect 3 product FAQ verticals, embed docs, vector store, 2 chat flows. Measure: p95 latency, token consumption, answer quality (human eval).

Open items:
- Finance: confirm whether invoice required during pilot and signatory.
- Legal: any additional DPA? Likely standard.
- SE: create short checklist for SSO proof-of-concept and sample prod network call trace for latency expectations.
